name: SuperbCrew

sources.title: About page — 'business news website covering innovative companies'; editor-in-chief publishes pitch contact editor@superbcrew.com; site actively runs funding news and founder interviews
Join us — hiring page (WordPress webmaster, growth hacker), not a contributor/submission route; contact hello@superbcrew.com
Advertise — linked in main nav; indicates a paid promotion channel exists alongside editorial

conditions: Free path is a cold editorial pitch to editor@superbcrew.com — coverage is at the editor's discretion; there is no submission form guaranteeing a listing
A paid /advertise/ channel exists, so sponsored coverage may be offered instead of free editorial
requirements: Newsworthy angle: the front page is dominated by funding announcements ($Xm raises), founder/CEO interviews, and product launches — a plain 'we exist' pitch will not land
Tech/business innovation fit; the site covers companies 'from the tech and business world'
Interview pitches should name the founder/executive available
preparation: A press-ready news hook: funding round, launch milestone, notable metric, or founder story
Company boilerplate, founder name/title, website URL
Optional: interview-ready founder with quotable angles (site runs a heavy interview format)
workflow: Draft a short pitch with the news hook in the subject line
Email editor@superbcrew.com (published on the About page)
Propose either a news write-up or the site's standard founder-interview format
If no reply, one polite follow-up; do not expect a tracking system or acknowledgment
watchFor: Editorial site, not a directory — there is no form and no guaranteed placement
'Join us' page is job hiring, not a contributor route — do not pitch it as a submission form
Paid /advertise/ exists; an offered 'partnership' reply may turn out to be a rate card — keep the ask clearly editorial if you want free
Recent stories skew toward large funding rounds; a small bootstrapped product may need a strong human-interest angle
countsAsLive: An article or interview mentioning the company is published and visible on superbcrew.com (news, interviews, or companies-to-watch sections)
unknowns: Whether 'Companies To Watch' entries are editorial picks or paid placements
